channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio diz que governo Lula usa PF para "perseguir oposição"
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro accused the Lula government of using the Federal Police to persecute the opposition and interfere in the 2026 elections, citing cases involving President Lula’s relatives, such as Lulinha and José Ferreira da Silva, and claiming the PF acts selectively while neglecting investigations into government allies.

item.title: China pode elevar tarifa da carne brasileira a 67%, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) accused the Lula government of failing in negotiations with China, which could result in a 67% tariff on Brazilian beef exports exceeding the annual quota of 1.1 million tons set for 2026. He also criticized the government’s handling of talks with the European Union, claiming that Brazil’s failure to meet antimicrobial use requirements in animal production led to its removal from the list of authorized exporters to the bloc.

item.title: Flávio diz que facções tornaram comunidade um “bairro fantasma” no CE
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro visited the Vila Velha community in Fortaleza (CE) and denounced criminal factions controlling the area, describing it as a "ghost neighborhood" due to resident displacement. He criticized state inaction and called for a bolder approach to combat crime, aligning with the PL’s public security narrative. The senator also attended a PL event in Ceará launching Alcides Fernandes’ Senate pre-candidacy, part of the party’s 2026 electoral strategy.

item.title: Justiça concede alvará de soltura de Márcio Canella
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes granted a release order to Márcio Canella, former mayor of Belford Roxo and Senate pre-candidate for União Brasil, following his arrest for illegal possession of a firearm during Operation Unha e Carne. The rifle was found in his vehicle, though Canella claimed it was not his. The ruling came Friday night after a custody hearing and his transfer to Bangu 8 prison.

item.title: Flávio sugere que criminosos preferem votar em Lula do que em Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro suggested that criminals are more likely to vote for Lula than for Bolsonaro during the launch of Alcides Fernandes' pre-candidacy for the Senate in Ceará. He criticized Lula's alleged leniency toward organized crime, advocated for harsher penalties, prison expansion, and lowering the age of criminal responsibility, and proposed chemical castration for rapists. Flávio also labeled the PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations and gave them an ultimatum to leave Brazil by December 31, 2026, or face imprisonment or neutralization.

item.title: Documentários dirigidos por mulheres registram política recente do Brasil
item.description: Recent documentaries directed by women, such as 'Anatomia do Caos' by Dandara Ferreira, 'Copan' by Carine Wallauer, and 'Apocalipse nos Trópicos' by Petra Costa, explore contemporary Brazilian political and social themes, from the Covid CPI to everyday democracy and the influence of evangelical voters. Despite national and international acclaim, the filmmakers highlight the persistent male dominance in the audiovisual industry and in the power structures they document, arguing that greater female participation expands the documentary’s potential as a tool of protest and reflection.

item.title: Com El Niño, governo deve elevar projeção oficial de inflação apesar da desaceleração em junho
item.description: Despite a recent slowdown in inflation in June, the Lula government is expected to raise its official inflation projection (IPCA) for the second half of 2024 due to anticipated stronger impacts from the El Niño phenomenon, which could drive up food and energy prices.

item.title: Caiado compara Flávio a um peru de Natal que Lula cuida para o segundo turno
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) compared Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to a 'Christmas turkey that Lula takes care of for the runoff,' suggesting the senator is seen as a weak candidate manipulated by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to ease Lula's path to victory in the 2026 election runoff. The remark marks a hardening of Caiado's tone against Flávio Bolsonaro, signaling the end of restraint in pre-election criticism.

item.title: PL guarda R$ 134 milhões do fundo partidário para candidatos, e Lula chega a eleição sem reserva
item.description: The PL and centrist parties accumulated R$134 million from the party fund and private contributions to boost their 2026 election campaigns, while the PT ended 2025 with a R$725,000 deficit and enters the race without reserves to fund Lula’s campaign. The disparity in party resources raises concerns about electoral fairness.

item.title: Brasil doou R$ 1,8 milhão em purificadores de água à Venezuela
item.description: Brazil donated R$1.8 million in solar-powered water purifiers to Venezuela as part of a broader humanitarian effort following the June 24, 2026 double earthquake that killed at least 3,889 people. The aid included eight humanitarian flights (six by the FAB and two commercial), field hospitals, medical supplies, health professionals, firefighters, search dogs, and technical teams. Coordination is led by the Itamaraty via the ABC, and President Lula met with MST representatives to discuss aid delivery, though the meeting’s outcomes remain undisclosed.

item.title: Haddad critica fala sobre Marina e Tebet e diz que Tarcísio também não é de SP
item.description: Fernando Haddad, PT pre-candidate for governor of São Paulo, criticized statements made by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (PL) regarding Senate pre-candidates Marina Silva (Rede) and Simone Tebet (PSB), calling them unfounded. Haddad also noted that, although Tarcísio governs São Paulo, he was not born in the state, emphasizing that his connection to SP is merely administrative. The controversy occurred on October 7, 2026, at 10:52 PM, and is part of the growing debate over representation and legitimacy in São Paulo candidacies.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest testa Lula x Flávio às vésperas de decisão sobre novo tarifaço
item.description: Genial/Quaest has registered a 2026 presidential poll with the TSE, set for release on July 15, conducted July 10–13 with 2,004 respondents. The survey centers on the potential U.S. tariff increase on Brazilian goods, assessing voter awareness, perceived family impact, blame attribution, and whether Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro better represents national interests. It also evaluates Flávio’s U.S. trip, the Master case, Senator Jaques Wagner, the Desenrola program, MEI tax ceiling, and the Michelle-Flávio Bolsonaro family-political rift.

item.title: Milei diz que virá ao Brasil para lançamento da candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei announced he will visit Brazil on July 25, 2026, to support pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of the PL party convention that will formalize his presidential bid. In addition to attending the event, Milei plans to visit Brasília to meet with former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest following a conviction for attempted coup d'état. Milei also confirmed attendance at the inaugurations of Keiko Fujimori in Peru and Abelardo de la Espriella in Colombia, signaling broader coordination among right-wing leaders in Latin America.

item.title: Caiado diz que candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro está ‘afundando’
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), a pre-candidate for president, said Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) campaign is 'sinking', citing the PP-União Brasil federation's withdrawal of support. He claimed both Flávio and Lula are 'cut from the same cloth', accusing them of prioritizing personal interests over Brazil's and stating that voting for Flávio amounts to re-electing Lula. Caiado also condemned Flávio's request to the U.S. government to delay 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods until after the election as 'unacceptable'.

item.title: Ato com Flávio no Ceará tem indireta para Michelle, e deputado do PL chama Bolsonaro de 'nosso galego'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro attended a political event in Fortaleza, marked by criticism of the PT and an indirect jab at Michelle Bolsonaro by federal deputy André Fernandes (PL). The absence of councilwoman Priscila Costa, an ally of the former first lady, was noted. Fernandes also referred to Bolsonaro as 'nosso galego'.

item.title: Ato do PL com Flávio Bolsonaro no Ceará tem indiretas a Michelle e protesto contra Ciro Gomes
item.description: The PL held an event in Fortaleza with Flávio Bolsonaro to launch pre-candidacies, including Alcides Fernandes for the Senate, featuring indirect references to Michelle Bolsonaro and protests against an alliance with Ciro Gomes. Flávio addressed women with proposals on public security and gender policies, while André Fernandes stirred family tensions by expressing nostalgia for Jair Bolsonaro, using the term 'galego' linked to Michelle. The event saw 'Ciro não' signs and audience disruption, with leaders urging to ignore alleged PT infiltrators.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro cobra governo Lula por sobretaxa da China sobre carne brasileira
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro blamed the Lula government for a potential 55% surcharge by China on Brazilian beef exports exceeding the annual quota, which could raise total tariffs to 67% on excess volume. He noted the quota is nearly exhausted (98.5% used by June), prompting exporters to front-load shipments, and projected a significant drop in Brazil’s beef exports to China in Q3, with domestic supply effects.

item.title: Sem Michelle, Flávio promete vouchers para creches e microcrédito a mulheres em primeiro ato após crise
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro promised vouchers for mothers to enroll children in private daycare when public spots are unavailable and expanded microcredit lines for women entrepreneurs at a PL event in Ceará, his first agenda since the rift with Michelle Bolsonaro. He also advocated for harsher criminal penalties for rapists aged 14 and older, linking public safety to his presidential campaign, while avoiding direct reference to the split with the former first lady.

item.title: Quem são os pré-candidatos ao governo de Sergipe (SE) nas eleições 2026
item.description: In the 2026 elections, five pre-candidates are running for governor of Sergipe: current governor Fábio Mitidieri (PSD), seeking re-election with support from PSD, PP, União Brasil, PT, and President Lula; in opposition, Valmir de Francisquinho (Republicanos), former mayor of Itabaiana, tied in polls; Ricardo Marques (PL), vice-mayor of Aracaju; Emanuel Cacho, president of the PSDB-Cidadania Federation in the state; and Dr. Helton Monteiro (PSOL), physician and president of Sindimed, announced as candidate after Niully Campos withdrew.

item.title: Processo contra Silvio Almeida aguarda citação há quatro meses
item.description: The case against former Minister Silvio Almeida, accused of sexual harassment by former Minister Anielle Franco, has been stalled for four months awaiting service of process at the STF. His defense denies any intent to avoid citation and expresses confidence in proving his innocence, while Almeida says he is eager to have his day in court.

item.title: Haddad diz ter ficado “perplexo” com declaração de Tarcísio sobre Tebet e Marina
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT's pre-candidate for governor of São Paulo, called Governor Tarcísio de Freitas's criticisms of former ministers Simone Tebet (MDB) and Marina Silva (Rede) an 'aggression,' saying he was left 'perplexed' by the remarks. He implied that others who heard the comments were also surprised or unsettled. The statement comes amid the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race.

item.title: ‘Agressão gratuita’: A reação de Haddad após Tarcísio criticar Marina e Tebet
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) labeled as a 'gratuitous attack' the criticisms by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) against Senate pre-candidates Marina Silva (Rede) and Simone Tebet (PSB), who were accused of seeking a seat in São Paulo due to lack of electoral viability in their home states. Haddad defended the former ministers, highlighting their public service and denouncing a double standard in the electoral race.

item.title: Governo Lula se prepara para taxação dos EUA
item.description: The Lula government considers the proposed U.S. tariffs on Brazil as inevitable, with potential implementation starting July 15, 2026. Although the government did not attend the USTR public hearings, it sent two observers, while Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, participated. The Planalto views the tariffs as unjustified and rejects calls for delay, interpreting them as politically motivated rather than economically grounded.

item.title: Haddad diz que nem Doria nem Tarcísio queriam ser governadores de SP: Estavam de Passagem
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT's pre-candidate for governor of São Paulo, stated that neither Tarcísio de Freitas nor João Doria intended to remain in office, describing their tenures as merely transitional. He implied both were more focused on personal or national ambitions than effective governance of the state.

item.title: “Você quer os EUA do chapeiro ou a ditadura de Cuba?”, diz Eduardo
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL) mocked a viral incident on social media in which an iFood customer paid for a pizza in three installments, dressing as a waiter to reference his past job flipping burgers at a U.S. diner. He provocatively asked whether voters prefer 'the USA of the waiter' or 'Cuba's dictatorship,' linking consumer behavior and economic choices to the political model Brazil should adopt.

item.title: Caiado critica candidatura de Flávio e diz que 'o barco está afundando e os aliados já começaram a pular fora'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD's pre-candidate for president, criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) campaign, stating that 'the boat is sinking and allies are already jumping ship,' referring to the lack of support from parties like União Brasil and Progressistas. He argued that Flávio's actions harm the right-wing cause and could inadvertently elect Lula, particularly criticizing his stance on a potential U.S. tariff increase and his ties to Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master.

item.title: A ‘guerra fria’ nos bastidores da investigação sobre Lulinha no STF
item.description: The investigation into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) at the STF is stalled due to the PF’s lack of personnel to analyze evidence, while his defense and businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger have requested the case be archived. Although the broader INSS fraud probe advances in other lines, the case involving the president’s son remains deadlocked, raising concerns about its electoral impact. Political scientist Rafael Cortez warns that suspicions of corruption involving public pension funds—though not yet producing significant electoral consequences—constitute a vulnerability for Lula’s 2026 re-election campaign.

item.title: Lula e Delcy conversam por telefone após terremotos na Venezuela
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva spoke by phone with Venezuelan interim president Delcy Rodríguez about the June 24 earthquakes, expressing Brazil’s humanitarian aid and reaffirming support for reconstruction and assistance to affected populations. Venezuela reported 3,889 deaths, 16,740 injured, and 17,907 displaced. Lula had previously spoken with Delcy on June 25 and in January following the U.S. operation that captured Nicolás Maduro.

item.title: Haddad afirma que crítica de Tarcísio a Tebet e Marina por disputa em SP foi 'uma agressão gratuita a duas mulheres'
item.description: Haddad criticized Tarcísio de Freitas' remarks against Marina Silva and Simone Tebet as a 'gratuitous aggression against two women', emphasizing their public service and former senatorial roles. Tarcísio had claimed the ex-ministers did not choose São Paulo to serve and received a 'red card' from Mato Grosso do Sul and Acre, asserting they would not win there or in SP. Tebet and Marina responded by highlighting their ties to São Paulo and accusing Tarcísio of bias and double standards.

item.title: Ciro Gomes fica fora de ato do PL no Ceará
item.description: Ciro Gomes, the tucano pre-candidate for governor of Ceará, did not attend the PL event in Fortaleza, where Senator Flávio Bolsonaro launched the party’s candidacies in the state. His absence reinforces the intention of both groups to limit their political partnership to the state level, without national repercussions.

item.title: EBC aciona o TSE para manter no ar reportagens da Agência Brasil
item.description: The EBC has appealed to the TSE to keep Agência Brasil's reports online, which were archived during the electoral blackout, arguing that journalistic content should not be equated with institutional advertising. According to Fenaj, approximately 146,000 pieces of content were removed, restricting public access to government information. The EBC seeks legal clarification or objective criteria to distinguish journalism from electoral propaganda.

item.title: Haddad chama críticas de Tarcísio a Marina e Tebet de 'agressão gratuita a duas mulheres'
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT's pre-candidate for governor of São Paulo, labeled Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' criticisms of Senate pre-candidates Marina Silva and Simone Tebet as a 'gratuitous attack on two women'. He said he was 'perplexed' by Tarcísio's remarks, arguing that political debate should focus on ideas, not personal attacks. The comments were made ahead of Haddad's appearance on the podcast 'Derrubando Muros'.

item.title: Milei anuncia viagem ao Brasil para apoiar pré-candidatura de Flávio
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei announced he will visit Brazil on July 25 to support Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential pre-candidacy. He will attend the officialization ceremony in São Paulo.

item.title: Mendonça suspende processo de concessão de novas linhas da ANTT
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça suspended the ANTT's process for granting new interstate road transport lines following a lawsuit by Anatrip, which argued the process violated a prior STF ruling allowing service provision via simple authorization. The suspension was based on an MPF opinion highlighting critical technical flaws, including lack of encryption, audit logs, and authentication mechanisms, plus an evident risk of harm to a protected legal good. Mendonça granted ANTT a 10-day deadline to address the security concerns raised.

item.title: “Fechou o valor do Pres Valdemar?”: leia as mensagens obtidas pela PF
item.description: Federal Police obtained messages revealing a scheme to divert parliamentary amendments coordinated by Valdemar Costa Neto, PL president, without elected office. Chamber of Deputies servants, including Mariângela Fialek, Nara Benedetti, and Garigham Amarante, allegedly facilitated the allocation of R$119.2 million in amendments, focused on tourism, based on recovered phone dialogues. Minister Flávio Dino of the STF ordered asset blocking based on the evidence, suggesting possible responsibility crime and embezzlement.

item.title: Milei diz que virá ao Brasil para evento do PL e visita a Bolsonaro
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei confirmed he will visit Brazil on July 25 to attend the PL party's national convention in São Paulo, invited by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the party's pre-candidate for president. During his trip, Milei also plans to visit Brasília to meet with former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest. Milei reiterated his support for Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy and expressed hope that the 'blue wave' of right-wing momentum in South America will extend to Brazil in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula conversa com presidente da Venezuela e oferece ajuda para reconstrução do país após terremotos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva phoned Venezuela's acting president, Delcy Rodríguez, to offer Brazilian government assistance for reconstruction following June's earthquakes, which caused 3,685 deaths and nearly 17,000 injuries. Lula reaffirmed Brazil's commitment to continue humanitarian aid, including shipments of medicines, water purifiers, and field hospital infrastructure, as well as support from the MST with doctors and food supplies.

item.title: Em telefonema, Delcy agradece ajuda do Brasil e Lula reafirma apoio à reconstrução da Venezuela
item.description: President Lula spoke with Venezuelan Presidenta Delcy Rodríguez by phone to reaffirm Brazil's support for reconstruction efforts following the June earthquakes that killed nearly 4,000 people. During the call, Delcy thanked Brazil for humanitarian aid and detailed ongoing victim searches and plans to rebuild housing for thousands of displaced families. Brazil has so far sent six humanitarian flights, 60 tons of supplies, a field hospital, and rescue teams, and is preparing a new phase of assistance.

item.title: Haddad diz que críticas de Tarcísio a Tebet e Marina foram ‘agressão gratuita’ a duas mulheres
item.description: Fernando Haddad criticized Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' remarks as a 'gratuitous aggression' against Senate pre-candidates Marina Silva and Simone Tebet, emphasizing their public service and right to run in São Paulo. Haddad accused Tarcísio of hypocrisy, noting the governor himself is not a São Paulo native and transferred his electoral domicile to the state in 2022. He also claimed that recent São Paulo governors, including Doria and Tarcísio, have prioritized presidential ambitions over state planning.

item.title: Haddad, sobre rejeição: A campanha é um pouco nacionalizada, não tem como se dissociar
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT's pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, attributed the 47% rejection rate recorded by Datafolha to the nationalization of the state race and the influence of social media on electoral debate, stating that the campaign cannot dissociate itself from these national factors.

item.title: EUA convidam chanceler brasileiro para evento sobre terrorismo político
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio invited Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira to attend a July 16 event on the 'resurgence of transnational left-wing extremist terrorism' as defined by the Trump administration. The invitation follows diplomatic tensions, including Washington's dismissal of Vieira's remarks about potential U.S. military action in Brazil as 'absurd', and the State Department's prior denial of any military intervention in Brazil.

item.title: Pré-campanhas de presidenciáveis se dividem sobre uso de inteligência artificial nas eleições
item.description: Presidential pre-campaigns are divided on the use of artificial intelligence in elections: while Lula’s PT advocates using AI only as a support tool without replacing the candidate’s image and criticizes opponents for manipulating truth, allies of Flávio Bolsonaro say they will use IA within legal limits, citing engagement. The PT released a social media video denouncing the use of AI to create 'fake candidates,' referring to the bolsonarist opposition.

item.title: Ciro evita ato de Flávio e sinaliza que aliança entre PSDB e PL ficará restrita ao Ceará
item.description: Ciro Gomes avoided attending the PL’s campaign launch event in Ceará led by Flávio Bolsonaro, signaling that the PSDB-PL alliance will remain limited to the state. Although the agreement includes mutual support — PL backing Ciro for governor and PSDB endorsing Alcides Fernandes for Senate — both sides wish to avoid a national political association due to potential costs. The move reflects a strategy to keep agendas separate, considering Ciro’s past ties to Lula and Flávio’s reluctance to align nationally with bolsonarismo beyond Ceará.

item.title: Edinho liga para Patrus, diretório sinaliza apoio e definição do candidato do PT em Minas depende de conversa com Lula
item.description: The national PT leadership approached federal deputy Patrus Ananias to discuss a possible candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais, with the state directory's approval. The decision hinges on a conversation between Patrus and President Lula, who is expected to formally invite him to run. Patrus, a former mayor of Belo Horizonte and minister under Lula and Dilma, is regarded as a historic figure capable of building broad support for the state race.

item.title: O novo telefonema de Lula para a presidenta da Venezuela
item.description: President Lula called Venezuela's interim president Delcy Rodríguez to reaffirm Brazil's solidarity following the June 24 earthquakes. Rodríguez thanked Brazil for sending 12 tons of medical supplies and conducting over 1,200 medical consultations. She reported that search efforts for victims continue and that Venezuela is preparing for reconstruction, focusing on housing for the 17,907 people left homeless.

item.title: Milei diz que pretende visitar Bolsonaro durante viagem ao Brasil
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei announced he will visit Brazil in late July, intending to meet with former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest, and attend the PL national convention in São Paulo to support Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy. The meeting with Bolsonaro requires authorization from Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Milei also outlined a South American tour including Peru, Colombia, and Ecuador.

item.title: Milei anuncia viagem ao Brasil em julho para apoiar candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Planalto
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei announced a trip to Brazil on July 25 to support Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential pre-candidacy, with events in São Paulo and a visit to jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro in Brasília. The meeting underscores a broader strategy of aligning with the international right, following a prior meeting in Argentina where Milei had already endorsed Bolsonaro as the 'presidential candidate'.

item.title: Patrus avança com candidatura em MG e baterá martelo em reunião com Lula
item.description: Deputy Patrus Ananias (PT-MG) awaits a meeting with President Lula to finalize his candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais in 2026, following pressure from the national PT leadership. Despite launching a pre-candidacy for federal deputy re-election, he remains open to running for the state government, viewed as a respected figure with strong polling numbers. The PT is pursuing its own candidacy after the withdrawal of allies like Rodrigo Pacheco and Kalil, while Marília Campos has agreed to run for the Senate.

item.title: Lula telefona para Delcy e promete ajudar na reconstrução da Venezuela
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva pledged Brazilian support for Venezuela's reconstruction following deadly earthquakes that left nearly 4,000 dead and caused an estimated $37 billion in damages. In a phone call with Venezuelan Vice President Delcy Rodríguez, Lula reaffirmed Brazil's solidarity and confirmed the delivery of humanitarian aid, including 210 tons of food and medical supplies, as well as the deployment of over 80 firefighters in UN-coordinated rescue operations.

item.title: Partido Novo pagou R$ 385 mil à empresa de Deltan Dallagnol via fundo partidário
item.description: The Novo Party transferred R$385,000 via party funds in 2025 to a company owned by former federal prosecutor and congressman Deltan Dallagnol. The company, in which Dallagnol, his wife, and children are partners, received the money according to TSE data. The payment raises concerns about the use of public funds to benefit entities linked to political figures within the party.
